Well, still Botox and we're starting to increase the amount of Botox to help prevent those dynamic lines from becoming static lines. We're starting to see a little bit more volume loss so mid-face filler, nasolabial filler and even perioral filler can help, jawline filler might be helpful and then small micro injections of hyaluronic acid in the neck can also be helpful when we're starting to see changes in the neck and then topical treatments at home should likely involve antioxidants like a vitamin C product and then retinols at night. Now what are some surgical procedures that patients in their 30s are looking for?
